setting.customColors.help: Your own two gradient colours. Picking one sets Palette to Custom
module.instantReplay.description: Saves the last few moments as a clip
setting.instantReplay.length.help: How far back a clip goes. Longer clips use more memory
setting.instantReplay.resolution.help: Native keeps the window's own size. Lower costs the game less
setting.instantReplay.fps.help: The clip's frame rate. 60 is a good balance
module.nametags.description: Clearer name tags with health and distance
module.targetHud.description: Shows the health of who you are fighting
module.potionHud.description: Shows your effects and the time left
module.armorHud.description: Shows your armor and how worn it is
module.sessionInfo.description: Shows play time, kills, FPS and ping
module.crosshair.description: A cleaner crosshair with hit markers
module.lootBeams.description: Light beams on dropped items by rarity
module.bedEsp.description: Shows beds and what is guarding them
setting.bedEsp.tagDistance.help: Beds farther than this keep their outline but show no tag
setting.bedEsp.show.help: Outline: the bed. Tag: team and distance. Defense: what covers it. Gaps: open sides, in red
module.storageEsp.description: Shows chests and shulkers through walls
module.trajectories.description: Shows where your shots and projectiles in flight land
module.dynamicIsland.description: A small pill at the top that shows the time
module.rearview.description: A small mirror that shows what is behind you
setting.rearview.fps.help: How often the mirror updates at most
setting.rearview.budget.help: How much time the mirror may use each frame. Lower keeps your FPS higher
setting.rearview.levelView.help: Keeps the mirror level with you even when you look up or down
setting.rearview.mirror.help: Flipped like a real mirror, so things on your left stay on the left
setting.rearview.maxDistance.help: How far the mirror draws the world. Shorter is cheaper
module.menuTheme.description: Gives Minecraft's menus the client's style
module.waterEsp.description: Shows players and items through walls as water
setting.waterEsp.teamColor.help: Players in their team colour in Bedwars, Skywars and similar
setting.waterEsp.shine.help: How bright the light rippling through the water is
setting.watermark.text.help: The name shown. Leave it empty to show the mark alone
setting.watermark.layout.help: Pill: everything on one line. Card: the name over a line of info, the mark beside both. Text: the words alone over the world, with a soft shadow. Badge: the name on a chip in its color, the info after it
setting.watermark.logo.help: Snowflake: the client's mark. Letter: the name's first letter on a tile. None: the name alone
setting.watermark.info.help: What follows the name. Ping shows on a server once it is known. With none picked, the card shows the version under the name
setting.watermark.separator.help: What goes between the name and each item: a thin bar, a dot, a slash or a space
setting.watermark.align.help: How the card's two lines line up with each other
setting.dynamicIsland.layout.help: Pill: everything on one pill. Split: the time on its pill, each extra and the battery on a bubble of its own beside it. Stacked: the time large, the rest small under it
setting.dynamicIsland.items.help: Shown after the time, between small dots. Ping shows on a server once it is known. World time is the game's own clock
setting.dynamicIsland.batteryIcon.help: Battery: a small battery that fills. Bar: a slim level. None: the percentage alone, in the charge's color when low
setting.dynamicIsland.lowBattery.help: Under this charge the battery turns amber; under 10% it turns red
setting.sessionInfo.rows.help: Which stats it shows. K/D: kills per death. Distance: how far you walked this session. Ping shows on a server once it is known
setting.sessionInfo.layout.help: Rows: a label and its value on each row. Compact: one line, each label before its value. Grid: cells, the value large over its label
setting.sessionInfo.title: Title
setting.sessionInfo.valueColor.help: Text: the HUD's text color. Accent: the accent. Palette: the palette's color. A slow ping still turns amber or red
setting.sessionInfo.speedUnit.help: b/s: blocks a second. km/h: kilometers an hour (a block is a meter). b/t: blocks a tick
setting.sessionInfo.graphStyle.help: Area: a line over a soft fill. Line: the line alone, a dot at its newest point. Bars: a bar for every fifth of a second
setting.frost_notifications.Stack.help: Auto: up from a bottom corner, down from a top one. Up or Down: always that way
setting.frost_notifications.Entrance.hel: Slide: in from the side. Drop: in from the stack's edge, up or down. Fade: fades in where it is. Pop: grows from a little smaller. They leave the same way
setting.frost_notifications.Duration.hel: How long each card stays, as a share of the time it asks for (a toggle asks for 2 seconds)
setting.frost_notifications.Compact.help: One line: the detail after the title, on a lower card
setting.frost_notifications.Width.help: Fit: cards grow with their text. Fixed: every card as wide as Card width, long text cut
setting.frost_notifications.Card-Width.h: Fit: the least a card is wide. Fixed: every card's width
setting.frost_notifications.Icon.help: Dot: a dot on a soft disc. Symbol: a check, cross, i or ! on a soft disc. Stripe: a bar along the card's left edge. None: text only
setting.frost_notifications.Status-Color: Accent: the accent for on and news, red for off and errors. Traffic: green for on, red for off and errors, the accent for news
setting.frost_notifications.Time-Bar.hel: The time left, as a line that runs down: along the foot, along the top, up the right edge, or none
setting.frost_notifications.Text-Size.he: The title's and the detail's size; the card grows with them
setting.frost_notifications.Show-Toggles: Cards for modules turned on or off
setting.frost_notifications.Show-Message: Cards for client news: a config saved, a friend added, and the like
setting.frost_interface.info-brand.help: The name at the start of the client info. Empty: the parts alone
setting.frost_interface.info-ping.help: Shows on a server once it is known
setting.frost_interface.info-server.help: The server's address (Singleplayer in a world of your own)
setting.frost_interface.info-separator.h: What goes between two parts of the client info
setting.frost_interface.info-style.help: Shadow: a soft shadow under the words. Plain: the words alone. Card: on a small HUD card
setting.frost_interface.info-in-chat.hel: While the chat is open the info sits under its input: dimmed, hidden, or shown as usual
setting.frost_interface.outline-when.hel: Commands: while a command is typed (it starts with a dot). Always: whenever the chat is open
setting.frost_interface.shape.help: The corners of the chat outline and of the client info's card: round, square, or cut off at 45 degrees
setting.frost_interface.outline-radius.h: How round the outline's corners are
setting.frost_interface.outline-glow.hel: A soft glow in the outline's color round the chat box
setting.arraylist.infoStyle.help: How the info is set off from the name: plain, in brackets or parentheses, after a dash, or after a thin divider
setting.arraylist.hideCategories.help: Modules of these categories stay out of the list
setting.arraylist.sort.help: Longest or shortest row first, by name, or by category (longest first within each)
setting.arraylist.letterCase.help: No spaces runs a name's words together (KillAura)
setting.arraylist.maxRows.help: Rows past this many are left out, in the order picked
setting.arraylist.align.help: The side the rows line up on. Auto follows where the list is placed
setting.arraylist.backdrop.help: A pill behind each row, one card behind the whole list, or only the text
setting.arraylist.marker.help: A tab on each row's outer side, a rail down the list, or a dot before each name, in the row's text colour
setting.arraylist.animation.help: How rows come and go: slide in from the edge, fade, pop in from small, or at once
setting.arraylist.gradientFlow.help: Across runs the gradient along each name; Down runs it down the list, a colour per row
setting.keybinds.show.help: Every bind, only modules that are on, or only hold or only toggle binds
setting.keybinds.hudBinds.help: Also lists the binds of HUD elements
setting.keybinds.sort.help: By name, by key, modules that are on first, or by category
setting.keybinds.maxRows.help: Binds past this many are left out, in the order picked
setting.keybinds.title: Title
setting.keybinds.titleText.help: Your own title. Empty shows Keybinds
setting.keybinds.keyStyle.help: Pill fills with the accent, Box is an outlined key, Keycap presses down when on, Text shows [K]
setting.keybinds.keyWidth.help: Fit makes each key as wide as its own name; Uniform makes every key as wide as the widest
setting.keybinds.indicator.help: What shows a module is on: its key lighting up, or a dot, a switch or ON/OFF at the row's end
setting.keybinds.holdTag.help: How a hold bind is marked: the word hold, a HOLD badge, or not at all
setting.keybinds.nameOn.help: The name's colour while its module is on (it is muted while off)
setting.potionHud.layout.help: Rows with a bar, Compact one-line rows, Tiles of icons with the time under each, or plain Text lines
setting.potionHud.sort.help: Longest or shortest time first, by name, or good effects first
setting.potionHud.levelOne.help: Also shows the level of a level one effect
setting.potionHud.bar.help: The time left as a line, as a tint filling the row (or rising in the tile), or not at all
setting.potionHud.barColor.help: The effect's own colour, the accent, or green to red by the time left
setting.potionHud.nameColor.help: The text colour, the effect's own colour, or green for good and red for bad effects
setting.potionHud.warnAt.help: The time turns red under this many seconds. Off at 0
setting.potionHud.blink.help: An ending effect's time and icon blink
setting.potionHud.hideAmbient.help: Leaves out effects from a beacon or a conduit
setting.potionHud.hideEndless.help: Leaves out effects that never run out
setting.armorHud.layout.help: A row, a column, or a grid as square as the items allow
setting.armorHud.durability.help: As a bar, a percent, the points left, a tint rising behind the item, or not at all
setting.armorHud.durabilityColor.help: Green to red by wear, the accent, or the text colour
setting.armorHud.showFull.help: Also shows the durability of items that have not taken damage yet
setting.armorHud.warnAt.help: An item worn down under this share pulses red. Off at 0
setting.armorHud.extras.help: How many of these you carry, each shown as one more item with its total
setting.armorHud.wells.help: A soft well behind each item
setting.armorHud.emptySlots.help: Keeps empty armor slots in place, with the game's faint outline of what goes there
setting.inventoryHud.show.help: The inventory, the inventory with the hotbar under it, or the hotbar alone
setting.inventoryHud.arrange.help: Items where they sit, the filled slots packed together, or one cell per kind of item with its total
setting.inventoryHud.slotStyle.help: Each slot as a soft well, an outline, a one-pixel grid between the slots, or nothing
setting.inventoryHud.emptyOpacity.help: How strong an empty slot's well or outline is
setting.inventoryHud.counts.help: Counts and durability as the game draws them, in the HUD's own font with a slim bar, or none
setting.inventoryHud.title: Title
setting.inventoryHud.highlight.help: Items to mark in the accent: item ids, comma separated (golden_apple, ender_pearl)
setting.inventoryHud.selected.help: Outlines the hotbar slot you hold
setting.inventoryHud.hideEmpty.help: Hides the card while what it shows is empty
setting.targetHud.layout.help: Detailed: face, name, health, bar and gear. Compact: one slim row with a small face. Minimal: a single line whose card is the health bar
setting.targetHud.face.help: Head: a player's face from their skin. Model: the live model of whatever you fight, mobs too. Off: no face
setting.targetHud.nameColor.help: Text: the HUD's text color. Team: the player's team color, when they have one
setting.targetHud.healthFormat.help: Number: 14.0. Percent: 70%. Hearts: 7.0 (two health to a heart). Fraction: 14.0/20
setting.targetHud.winning.help: A chip with your health minus theirs (absorption counted): green and pointing up when you are ahead, red and down when behind
setting.targetHud.barStyle.help: Gradient: the palette's gradient. Health: the health's own color, green to red. Segmented: one cell per heart
setting.targetHud.trail.help: What a hit took stays on the bar as a pale trail for a moment, then drains
setting.targetHud.hurtFlash.help: The face turns red and the card's edge flashes when they are hit
setting.targetHud.durability.help: Durability bars and stack counts on the gear
setting.targetHud.hold.help: How long the card stays up after the fight ends. If they died it shows them at 0
setting.crosshair.preset.help: Cross: arms and a dot. Dot: one dot. Circle: a ring. Valorant: sharp pixel arms with faint outer arms. Chevron: a caret under the center. Brackets: four corners round it. Tri: three arms
setting.crosshair.shape.help: Rounded: a round dot and rings. Squared: a square dot, square rings and sharp corners, on whole pixels
setting.crosshair.tips.help: Flat: square ends. Round: round ends. Pointed: each arm tapers to a point toward the center
setting.crosshair.rotation.help: Turns the crosshair. 45° makes an X
setting.crosshair.arms.help: Which arms show. Leave out the top one for a T
setting.crosshair.spread.help: How far the arms open while you move, jump or recover from a swing
setting.crosshair.onTarget.help: Takes another color while an entity you can hit is under it
setting.crosshair.chargeStyle.help: Ring: a ring that fills round the crosshair (a square frame when squared). Bar: a short bar under it
setting.crosshair.reachRing.help: A faint ring (corner brackets when squared) when what you aim at is close enough to hit
setting.crosshair.thirdPerson.help: Shows it in third person too, where the game hides its own
setting.crosshair.hideInScreens.help: Hidden while a screen is open: chat, your inventory, menus
setting.rearview.aspect.help: Wide: the original. Panorama: wider and lower. 16:9 and 4:3 like a screen. Square
setting.rearview.showWhen.help: Always. Players behind: only while a player is behind you, in range. In combat: only while you fight. Hidden, it costs nothing
setting.rearview.frame.help: Card: on its card with a slim margin. Bezel: set into the card behind a bevelled edge. Bare: the image alone, no card
setting.rearview.label: Label
setting.rearview.label.help: Badge: a small tag over the image's corner. Title: a strip above the image with its frame rate
setting.rearview.brightness.help: Darkens the mirror so it draws less of your eye
setting.frost_keystrokes.Layout.help: Standard: the mouse keys under WASD. Mouse-Top: over it. Side: in a column beside it
setting.frost_keystrokes.Radius.help: How round the keys' corners are. The style's Corner size scales it
setting.frost_keystrokes.Idle-Alpha.help: How solid a key is when not pressed: the keys' background opacity
setting.frost_keystrokes.Key-Labels.help: Letters: W, A, S, D. Bound: the keys they are bound to. Arrows: arrows on the movement keys
setting.frost_keystrokes.Label-Color.hel: Theme: the HUD's text color. Custom: your own. A pressed key's label still turns to what reads on it
setting.frost_keystrokes.Press-Style.hel: Fill: the key fills with your color. Grow: the fill grows out from its middle. Outline: only its edge lights up
setting.frost_keystrokes.Animation-Speed: How fast keys light up and fade
setting.frost_keystrokes.Movement-Keys.h: W, A, S and D. Off with Mouse keys on: only the mouse
setting.frost_keystrokes.CPS-Style.help: Below: under the button's name. Instead: in place of the name, bigger
setting.frost_keystrokes.Space-Mark.help: Line: a short line in the bar. Label: its name. None: an empty bar
module.animations.description: Changes how your held item is posed and swung in first person
setting.animations.style.help: Default: the game's own hold and swing, to start from and tune with the options below. 1.8 Block: the sword always held across the screen as when blocking in 1.8; a hit dips it down to the left and it comes back up to the right. Bash: the block shoved forward. Slash: a wide diagonal cut. Stab: a thrust at the crosshair. Chop: drawn up, then brought straight down. Sweep: a flat swipe across. Slide down: the item slides straight down and back up. Spin: a full turn in the hand. Whip: a flick that rings out. Orbit: the hand draws a loop. Drift: floats at rest and leans in to hit
setting.animations.when.help: Always: the style all the time. Attacking: only while you swing, gliding back after. Right-click: only while you hold right-click (right-click itself works as normal: nothing extra is sent). 1.8 Block is always shown
setting.animations.items.help: Which items in your hand get the style. Others are held as normal
setting.animations.speed.help: How fast the swing you see plays. Only the look: your real swings and hits keep the game's timing
setting.animations.easing.help: How a swing is paced. Smooth: eased in and out, so fast clicks flow together. Snappy: a quick hit and a slow settle. Heavy: gathers itself and lands late. Linear: an even pace, like vanilla. 1.8 Block has its own springy hit; Default keeps the game's pace
setting.animations.swing.help: How far the item moves in a swing. At 0% it stays still
setting.animations.x.help: Moves the item to the side, in blocks: out to the right, or in towards the middle below zero
setting.animations.y.help: Moves the item up, in blocks, or down below zero
setting.animations.z.help: Moves the item towards you, in blocks, or away below zero
setting.animations.scale.help: How big the item is drawn in your hand
setting.animations.noDip.help: Keeps the item up after a hit, as in 1.8, instead of lowering it while your attack recharges. Switching items still lowers it
setting.keystrokes.style.help: Flat: soft keys that fill with your color. Classic: solid theme keys that flash the color
setting.keystrokes.layout.help: Standard: the mouse keys under WASD. Mouse-Top: over it. Side: in a column beside it
setting.keystrokes.keyLabels.help: Letters: W, A, S, D. Bound: the keys they are bound to. Arrows: arrows on the movement keys
setting.keystrokes.pressStyle.help: Fill: the key fills with your color. Grow: the fill grows out from its middle. Outline: only its edge lights up
setting.keystrokes.cpsStyle.help: Below: under the button's name. Instead: in place of the name, bigger
setting.notifications.stack.help: Auto: up from a bottom corner, down from a top one. Up or Down: always that way
setting.notifications.entrance.help: Slide: in from the side. Drop: in from the stack's edge, up or down. Fade: fades in where it is. Pop: grows from a little smaller. They leave the same way
setting.notifications.duration.help: How long each card stays, as a share of the time it asks for (a toggle asks for 2 seconds)
setting.notifications.width.help: Fit: cards grow with their text. Fixed: every card as wide as Card width, long text cut
setting.notifications.icon.help: Dot: a dot on a soft disc. Symbol: a check, cross, i or ! on a soft disc. Stripe: a bar along the card's left edge. None: text only
setting.notifications.statusColors.help: Accent: the accent for on and news, red for off and errors. Traffic: green for on, red for off and errors, the accent for news
setting.notifications.timeBar.help: The time left, as a line that runs down: along the foot, along the top, up the right edge, or none
